## Submitting an Access Request via SailPoint ISC API

Use `POST /v3/access-requests` to grant a user an access profile, role, or entitlement.

### Authentication

Get a bearer token first via the OAuth2 client credentials flow:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "grant_type=client_credentials&client_id={clientId}&client_secret={clientSecret}"
```

### Submit the Access Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {access_token}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "requestedFor": ["<identity-id>"],
    "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
    "requestedItems": [
      {
        "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
        "id": "<access-profile-id>",
        "comment": "Access needed for project X"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

### Key Fields

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `requestedFor` | Array of identity IDs to grant access to |
| `requestType` | `GRANT_ACCESS` or `REVOKE_ACCESS` |
| `requestedItems[].type` | `ACCESS_PROFILE`, `ROLE`, or `ENTITLEMENT` |
| `requestedItems[].id` | ID of the target access profile/role/entitlement |
| `requestedItems[].comment` | Optional justification |
| `requestedItems[].removeDate` | Optional ISO-8601 date for temporary access (e.g. `"2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z"`) |

### Check Request Status

The response returns an access request ID. Poll its status with:

```bash
curl -X GET "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-request-status?filters=id+eq+%22{requestId}%22" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {access_token}"
```

### Python Example

```python
import requests

tenant = "your-org"
token = "your_bearer_token"

response = requests.post(
    f"https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests",
    headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    json={
        "requestedFor": ["2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"],
        "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
        "requestedItems": [
            {
                "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
                "id": "2c9180835d2e5168015d32f890ca1581",
                "comment": "Requesting access for onboarding",
            }
        ],
    },
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())
```

To find the identity ID, use `GET /v3/identities?filters=name+eq+"username"`. To find the access profile ID, use `GET /v3/access-profiles?filters=name+eq+"Profile Name"`.

  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/access-requests
    api_version: v3
  - method: GET
    path: /v3/access-request-status
    api_version: v3

```
